attributes.additional_details: Is to get protection for people who book a holiday, say as a couple or group booking then they split up or can’t go , those people have know right to the change booking or get their money back . Travel Company’s need to abolish the word Lead Passenger and give protection to everyone on a booking
attributes.background: I would like the government to change the way travel companies use the word Lead Passenger on a holiday booking. Everybody who has paid for holiday themselves should have protection over their money

rejection.details: Travel booking systems are a matter for travel companies, not the UK Government or Parliament.
